context.description: A server stop leaves the run resumable
context.gherkin:
Scenario: SV27 A server stop leaves the run resumable
    Given a live run with a building task and a verifying scenario
    When the instance scope closes without a job cancel
    Then the store holds no run.cancelled, no task.failed and no scenario.verified from the stop, and no summary is written
    And an interrupted worker never counts as a worker failure
    And the next /task with the same path records run.resumed
